blocks.name: E65-LADDER-randn
blocks.title: Hart ladder, randn operands, idle-bracketed

predicted.what: Board power over the bracketing idles is linear in harts. Scaling E62's 800 MHz line (5.80 W + 55.8 mW/hart on aifoundry2) to this card by f.V^2 = (600/800)(0.523/0.618)^2 = 0.537 gives 3.12 W + 30.0 mW/hart if the offset is switching work, or 5.80 W + 30.0 mW/hart if the offset is a fixed cost of having a launch open at all. The zeros session's slope is 10-40% of the randn session's; its intercept is the test.
predicted.basis: E62's CAL ladder and finding 11; E64's zeros-vs-random per-multiply-add energies

blocks.pass_rule: README.md block C, rules C1-C4. Every rung's statistic is the MEDIAN of the 10 Hz board samples in the last 4.0 s of its launch, minus the mean of the two bracketing idles' last 10 s medians; the raw line (no bracket subtraction) is reported beside it.

safety.note: aifoundry3 is pinned at 600 MHz, so there is no governor step to protect; 72 C on a full-card phase and 78 C absolute keep the die well inside the lab's 90 C rule.

conventions.power_window: the last 4.0 s of a launch, median of the 10 Hz samples (E62-CAL)
conventions.idle_window: the last 10.0 s of an IDLE phase, median
